signals.title: Packaging scale-up risk
signals.summary: Public sources establish Amkor/ASE partnerships and a very large 3D photonics package target — not that packaging is currently binding Lightmatter output. If Passage ramps, advanced packaging and interposer capacity could become limiting.

signals.title: Disclosed foundry dependency
signals.summary: GF Fotonix is a named manufacturing partner for silicon photonics. This establishes supply-path dependence — not that GF is the sole foundry or that capacity is presently gating shipments.

signals.title: L200 may lead commercially
signals.summary: L200 ships as a CPO/UCIe product with disclosed partners; secondary analysis suggests M1000 may trail on near-term deployability. Packaging partners could see earlier volume on L200 — not established as production fact.

signals.title: Qualification timeline gates revenue
signals.summary: EVK deployment is observed internal progress. Production timing and customer revenue remain inference from secondary analysis; no public design wins.

signals.title: Ecosystem path unproven
signals.summary: Lightmatter references NVLink Fusion on its site; revenue and design wins are undisclosed. Ecosystem participation may matter for adoption — comparative importance vs bandwidth is inference only.

signals.title: System-level optical link
signals.summary: Package CPO still connects to rack/cluster optical plant — a structural dependency. This does not establish quantified fiber-demand growth from Lightmatter scaling.
